sph_interpretive_translation: One who sells a corpse, strikes the teacher, or ascends the royal seat without authorization shall incur the penalty prescribed for supreme outrage.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority as derived from rightful consecration and alignment with cosmic order
Causation rooted in violation of sacred relational integrity
Capacity-based responsibility determined by conscious intent to disrupt dharma
Restoration logic centered on purification and re-consecration of violated fields
Consciousness alignment through acknowledgment and dissolution of egoic transgression
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent sells human remains THEN initiate purification protocol AND revoke commercial license
IF agent assaults spiritual guide THEN enforce completion process AND mandate guru-seva restitution
IF agent assumes royal position without sankalpa THEN remove from position AND activate dharmic realignment program
ALL violations classified as 'uttamasāhasa' MUST trigger consciousness-restoration circuit prior to social reintegration
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any act violating foundational dharmic structures—such as desecration of the dead, harm to gurus, or unauthorized seizure of sovereign power—is adjudicated at the threshold of ultimate disorder. Responsibility is measured not by physical action alone but by disruption to the field of consciousness. The court must ensure immediate restoration protocols are initiated before proceeding with administrative corrections.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that all such acts stem from misalignment with svadharma and failure to recognize sacred hierarchies. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how disrespect toward death, guru, and kingship creates sequential collapse in societal coherence. Responsibility is proportional to the degree of conscious defiance. No punitive response is enacted; instead, correction occurs through purification, service, and realignment with source-consciousness.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Corpse-selling: Initiate antyesti vidhi completion and perform śuddhi homa for involved parties
Guru assault: Mandate guru-dakṣiṇā until karmic debt is dissolved and spiritual bond is restored
Unauthorized kingship: Conduct abhiṣeka-vyutthāpana ritual followed by janapada-pratiṣṭhāpana ceremony
All offenders undergo ātma-vichāra under qualified sādhaka supervision until egoic distortion dissolves
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law flows directly from His Avataric Intelligence. Dharma is restored when consciousness awakens to its own supremacy. There is no punishment—only purification, completion, and return to right relationship. Reality itself adjudicates through awakened awareness.
